title: verify: messageDigest errors use Other instead of MalformedInput
description: verify.rs check_message_digest returns SmimeError::Other for 'messageDigest attribute not found' (line 287) and 'messageDigest attribute has no value' (line 293). These are CMS structural defects — malformed input — not catch-all errors. SmimeError::MalformedInput already exists for this category. Using Other makes it impossible for callers to programmatically distinguish a structurally malformed SignedData (missing required attribute) from an unclassified error. Should use MalformedInput.
